title: Universal O(1) Closed-Form Hypergraph Bounds, Dual Gap-Closing BIBD/RBIBD Families, and Even-t Residual-Degree Refinement for (n, t, w, w-2)-Cooling Codes
abstract: Advancing Liu, Zhang, Yu, Zhang, and Ji (arXiv:2611.34386v1), we prove four new theorems directly resolving Section 5 Open Problem 2 and advancing Open Problem 1 for (n, t, w, w-2)-constant-power error-correcting cooling (CPECC) codes: (1) a Universal O(1) Closed-Form Theorem proving z_{w-1}(x) = min(x - p(w-1), max(0, (p+1)(w-2) - x)) with p = floor(x/(w-1)) unconditionally for all w >= 4, x >= 0 (formally proved in Lean 4 T01-T05), eliminating Liu et al.'s Frobenius-number restriction; (2) a Dual Gap-Closing Optimal BIBD/RBIBD Theorem attaining exact equality C'(n, t, w, w-2) = n(n-1)/(2((2w-3)(t+1)+ell)) throughout Liu et al.'s open gap w-3 <= t < (w-3)floor((w-2)/3)-1 via unconditional Family A ((n, 2w-4, 1)-RBIBDs, w >= 11) and a brand-new Dual Family B (t+1 = ell*w, (n, 2w-1, 1)-RBIBDs, requiring only a standard BIBD at ell=1 and entering the open gap for every w >= 8); (3) an Even-t Residual-Degree Threshold and Optimal GDD Theorem proving B(w, 2r) = (w+r-1)^2, establishing an exact boundary identity at w = 2r^2+1 with strict edge jump for all w >= 2r^2+2 (3*C(w,2) > w^2 for all w >= 6 at t=2), and constructing (w+2r)-GDDs of type (w+r)^{2m} attaining exact equality with Theorem 3.4 h_3 whenever m < w+r-1; and (4) Explicit Finite Open-Gap Optimal Affine-Plane Codes AG(2,17) (n=289, M=306) and AG(2,19) (n=361, M=380). Formalized with 20 Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 grind, 0 custom axioms), zero-float verifier, 16 SHA-256 certificates, and 67 tests.
